slug: 2026-02-27 Who Protects Nigeria's Digital Citizens Unmasking Accountability Gaps in Digital Rights Governance

facts.fact: Dataphyte states the 2023 Data Protection Act created a formal Data Protection Commission, which critics say sits under ministerial control and needs ministerial clearance before acting; no event date given, so the published date is used.

Dataphyte, citing Freedom House's Freedom on the Net 2024, states that enforcement and protections remain inconsistent and that repeated breaches rarely translated into widely publicised sanctions; no count is given.

systems.owner: National Assembly; enforced by the NDPC
Federal Government; National Commissioner and CEO Vincent Olatunji
